instruction: Work out the monthly total sales in a new row called "Total" and then create a line chart to show the results (x-axis be Months).

candidates.name: Apply Revenue Cost Discount Profit Formulas
candidates.description: Build business-metric columns such as revenue, cost, discount, or profit from visible Calc source columns, then verify the target output column before moving on.

candidates.name: Create Sparklines or Cell Embedded Trend Visuals
candidates.description: Create compact cell-embedded trend or intensity visuals such as sparklines, data bars, or color scales when the task wants an in-cell visual result instead of a full chart canvas.

candidates.name: Format Calc Chart Elements and Series
candidates.description: Adjust chart legends, axes, series styles, labels, line types, and secondary-axis settings after the chart already exists.

candidates.name: Create Chart on Target Sheet with Exact Title and Type
candidates.description: Create a chart on the requested destination sheet while honoring an exact chart title and chart family.

candidates.name: Insert and Edit Charts
candidates.description: Insert a chart, open chart-specific editing surfaces, and verify the resulting chart data state before leaving chart editing.

candidates.name: Insert and Structure Calc Charts
candidates.description: Insert chart types, choose source ranges, and keep the wizard or chart canvas aligned with the requested structure before later formatting steps.

candidates.name: Create Calc Pivot Tables with Aggregations and Filters
candidates.description: Create Calc pivot tables from the intended source range, place fields into the correct layout buckets, choose non-default aggregations, and verify renamed or filtered pivot output on the result sheet.

candidates.name: Run Calc Statistical Tests and Summaries
candidates.description: Run statistical tools or summary functions that are more specialized than ordinary worksheet formulas.

candidates.name: Create and Format Tables
candidates.description: Insert new tables, change row or column structure, and apply table formatting such as fills, borders, or row height adjustments.

candidates.name: Build Merged Report Headers and Multi Row Layouts
candidates.description: Merge header ranges, handle hidden-cell warnings deliberately, and verify that multi-row report headers still span the intended block after the merge.
